content: Continuous use of real-time continuous glucose monitoring (rtCGM) in children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes has been shown to significantly improve blood glucose management. This often results in enhanced psychological well-being for both the patients and their families. Clinical trials have demonstrated that rtCGM alleviates the stress associated with glucose management for young patients and their parents. This reduction in stress contributes to better adherence to diabetes management protocols. In adults, particularly those managing their diabetes with multiple daily injections (MDI) or continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion (CSII), rtCGM has been associated with significant reductions in A1C levels, ranging from 0.3% to 0.9%. Additionally, it has been shown to decrease the frequency of hypoglycemic episodes, indicating improved overall diabetes control.
